title: Replacement Price Bonus Bands
content:
**Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — replacement price bonus bands**

The replacement purchase is the holder's most recently signed group purchase deal in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records: the deal whose vehicle price was charged last (of two charged the same day, the one recorded first), where that deal stands in contracted status. A bonus is added to the replacement vehicle credit according to that deal's cash price, the agreed selling price of the vehicle before fees, taxes, trade-in and deposits, as recorded on the deal in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records.

| Cash price of the replacement purchase | Bonus added |
|---|---|
| 40000.00 or more | 200.00 |
| 25000.00 or more but below 40000.00 | 100.00 |
| Below 25000.00 | None |

**Band edges.** 39999.99: 100.00. 40000.00: 200.00. 24999.99: none. 25000.00: 100.00.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A replacement deal at a cash price of 33480.00 adds 100.00; one at 46215.00 adds 200.00.
